title: App works for one user but not another
symptom: A business app opens for one user but fails for another on the same PC
user_description: When Ahmed signs into this PC, the invoice app works. When I sign in, it shows an error and closes. Same computer!

options.why: The app works for another user on the same PC, so Windows and the app install are fine.
Admin rights do not fix a profile or permission problem and add risk.
Her profile and access would bring the same problem along.

options.text: Since the PC is fine, look at her profile and access: compare with the working user, check the app's group permissions, and reset her app settings or cache
options.why: When one user fails on a working PC, the difference is in that user's settings or permissions.

hints: What is the same for both users, and what is different?
Where does an app keep each user's settings?
Could she be missing a permission Ahmed has?
real_world_tip: Per-user app settings usually live in the user's AppData folder. Renaming the app's folder there lets it start fresh without deleting anything.
